Subject: Next steps: Demo scheduling & rotating time slots

Hi Alex 

Thanks again for taking the discovery call yesterday. Quick recap: Acme Logistics is focused on improving inference latency for routing recommendations and consolidating model serving to reduce ops overhead. You mentioned three primary success criteria: (1) predictable per-token cost, (2) 99ms p50 latency for 2k seq workloads, and (3) an isolated deployment option for regulated freight datasets.

Next steps we discussed:
- 45-minute technical deep dive / demo with your infra + ML engineering leads
- Share a short pre-read (system design + data handling) and a proposed mutual action plan

To make scheduling easier across your US/EU/APAC stakeholders, we typically propose a rotating set of recurring slots so each time zone occasionally gets a friendly window. Below are three rotating weekly windows please let us know which one(s) work for your team and who from Acme should join.

Proposed rotating slots (we rotate the primary region each week):
- Slot A (Americas-friendly): Tue 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET  good for West/East coast engineering
- Slot B (EMEA-friendly): Wed 16:00 CEST / 10:00 ET  works for European ops and US afternoon overlap
- Slot C (APAC-friendly): Thu 09:00 SGT / Wed 17:00 PT  early APAC / late US overlap

Suggested cadence: 1) pick a primary recurring slot for the demo series, 2) rotate weekly among A/B/C so each region occasionally has a friendly time. If you'd prefer a one-off deep dive first, we can book a single 45-min session and follow with rotating office hours.

Attachments: redwood_product_one-pager.pdf (overview), acme_network_diagram.pdf (template pre-read)

Would you and Priya be available for Slot A or Slot B the week of Apr 19? If so, we can send an invite and include our demo engineers.

Thanks 
Camila Reyes
